'''The International Relief Alliance''' was a temporary emergency coalition formed during the [[Siege of Murah]] in 1891.

== Formation ==

The old source says the [[Northern Alliance]] proposed the relief alliance after anti-foreign rebels trapped diplomats, merchants, and other foreign communities in [[Murah]]. The coalition drew on states whose people were caught in the city, including Theorin, Vinterholm, Rhovland, Aurendale, Vespera, Solara, Astoria, and Gwangyanski interests.

== Operation ==

The relief force worked with the Volgastani-Hamed royal army to defend the city and extract foreign communities after seventy-one days of siege.

== Source Limits ==

This draft preserves the relief alliance as a temporary crisis coalition, not a permanent institution. Its exact membership list, commanders, and casualty figures need a later Murah military-detail pass.
